evidence_scope: mapped human 1YCR/Q00987 interface applied to elephant, mouse and hamster MDM2 embeddings
key_result: The mapped interface signal was reproducible, but the long-lived versus short-lived biological contrast was not robust.
quantitative_summary: Three audited mapped-interface enrichment rows; present_valid embeddings; deterministic controls.
decision: Do not promote MDM2 interface enrichment as a longevity adaptation.
next_step: Handle elephant TP53 retrogenes separately, copy by copy.
claim_boundary: Supports shared interface constraint, not beneficial breakage or lifespan causality.

evidence_scope: SIRT6 mini-pilot interface enrichment and manual-review outputs
key_result: Observed separation could not be interpreted as a longevity mechanism because it tracked broad sequence divergence.
quantitative_summary: Enrichment approximately 0.69-1.05; silhouette approximately 0.388; 118-residue manual-review shortlist.
decision: Do not expand the embedding-only SIRT6 contrast without stronger independent controls.
next_step: Use direct mechanistic sites or wet-lab evidence rather than further global embedding separation.
claim_boundary: Statistical separation is not evidence of a DNA-repair or longevity mechanism.

key_result: No reproducible longevity-associated shift was detected at the RHEB-MTOR interface.
claim_boundary: Does not rule out expression, localization or pathway-level regulation.

key_result: No coherent interface-level embedding shift separated the tested long-lived lineages.
next_step: Retain only direct downstream regulatory-site exceptions for targeted validation.
claim_boundary: Does not rule out altered kinase activity or network-state regulation.

key_result: NMR-associated substitutions produced reciprocal local embedding rescue in both human and NMR backgrounds.
quantitative_summary: Local rescue: human 0.7712, NMR 0.8302; global rescue about 0.185/0.194; reciprocal direction cosine 0.9681. Leading sites: 178/181 cluster, N301S and N178S.
decision: Retain as the strongest positive computational lane.
next_step: Test a multi-site wet-lab panel with matched single-site and cluster controls.
claim_boundary: Embedding rescue does not establish HAS2 activity, hyaluronan production, CD44 signaling or longevity.

evidence_scope: two structures at 6/7/8 angstrom interface cutoffs
key_result: No NMR-specific direct-interface substitutions were found.
quantitative_summary: Eight non-interface ectodomain substitutions were deferred.
next_step: Only revisit with receptor dynamics or expression evidence.
claim_boundary: Does not rule out non-interface receptor regulation.

key_result: Catalytic landmarks were conserved in all species.
quantitative_summary: TSC2 R1580K occurred in two of three long-lived lineages but was approximately 63 residues from the catalytic site.
decision: Do not promote the nonlocal variant without additional mechanism.
claim_boundary: A distant recurrent variant is not evidence of altered GAP activity.

evidence_scope: 7DL2 interface mapping, six-species alignment, reciprocal ESMC edits and local controls
key_result: TSC1 M771V recurred in NMR and Myotis and showed reciprocal local embedding rescue, but stronger nearby interface controls prevented a unique-hotspot claim.
quantitative_summary: Radius-8 rescue: human to NMR 40.50%, human to Myotis 33.32%, NMR to human 41.96%, Myotis to human 35.32%; direction cosines 0.966-0.983. Focal beat non-interface controls, not all interface controls.
decision: Retain as a regional two-lineage interface candidate.
next_step: Wet-lab panel: WT, M771V, M806V, M845V and V772M.
claim_boundary: Supports sequence-context sensitivity in an interface region, not altered binding or mTORC1 function.

evidence_scope: FOXO3 T32, S253 and S315 across seven species
key_result: All three phosphoacceptors and tested motif positions were conserved.
next_step: Any future work must test kinase activity, phosphatases, localization or expression.
claim_boundary: Sequence conservation does not establish equal phosphorylation dynamics.

evidence_scope: TSC2 S939, S981 and T1462 across seven species
quantitative_summary: Elephant-only arginine changes near S981 did not repeat in NMR or Myotis.
next_step: No embeddings for conserved site-presence questions.
claim_boundary: Does not rule out altered AKT activity, 14-3-3 binding or TSC localization.

evidence_scope: SIRT6 S10 and PARP1 K521 sequence mapping
key_result: PARP1 K521 was K in NMR and elephant but R in Myotis. Myotis SIRT6 N-terminus remained unresolved.
quantitative_summary: NMR K521 stable across four optimal alignments; local-window coverage 16/17.
decision: No shared longevity signal; preserve Myotis K521R as a species-specific candidate.
next_step: Targeted PARP1 functional assay or phospho/ADP-ribosylation evidence.
claim_boundary: Loss of the exact lysine does not establish altered PARP1 activity or DNA repair.

key_result: NMR lost the S467 phosphoacceptor; elephant preserved S; Myotis ULK1 was unavailable in queried UniProt and Ensembl annotations.
quantitative_summary: NMR full site coverage; Myotis translation_count=0.
decision: Preserve as an NMR-specific candidate, not a repeated longevity signal.
next_step: Comparative phosphoproteomics or a direct S467G functional test.
claim_boundary: Sequence loss does not establish altered ULK1 activity or autophagic flux.

evidence_scope: RPTOR S722 and S792 across three short-lived and two long-lived lineages
key_result: Both phosphoacceptors and their tested windows were conserved in NMR and Myotis.
next_step: No elephant rescue required for the repeated-signal question.
claim_boundary: Does not establish equal mTORC1 response dynamics.

evidence_scope: human ACACA S80 and ACACB S222 across seven species
key_result: ACACA S80 was conserved in all species. ACACB S222 was lost only in Myotis.
decision: No shared longevity signal; preserve the bat-specific ACC2 candidate.
claim_boundary: Sequence loss does not establish altered malonyl-CoA or fatty-acid oxidation.
